description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of next token prediction over a series of steps, comparing two different lines representing different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 60,000 with a tick label interval of 10,000. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40 with a tick label interval of 0.05. The blue line, representing one model or configuration, starts at approximately 0.25 on the y-axis at step 5,000 and increases to around 0.47 at step 50,000, with a solid line style and circular markers, showing a steady increase across the x-axis. The green line, representing another model or configuration labeled "EXZT", begins at around 0.29 at step 5,000, dips to 0.10 at step 10,000, and then rises to approximately 0.45 at step 40,000, also with a solid line style and circular markers, exhibiting a more variable trend across the x-axis.
